The '''Galarb district''' was a district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the location of the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] and [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].
